responsibility: Implements the minimal Assertion runtime service for GNU Modula-2 by testing a boolean condition and, on failure, emitting a fixed diagnostic through StrIO before terminating the program with M2RTS_HALT. Its responsibility is limited to runtime assertion failure handling; it does not provide general exception machinery or formatted diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: This implementation file contains the actual assertion failure behavior: on false input it writes the fixed message via StrIO and halts through M2RTS_HALT. Unlike gcc/m2/pge-boot/GAssertion.h, it provides the runtime action rather than only the single procedure declaration.
